/* 
Absorption coefficient of colored dissolved organic carbon
(CDOM) obtained by the following procedure:
	
1. Filter water samples through a 47 mm Whatman polycarbonate membrane
with a pore size of 0.22 micrometers.

2. Inject the filtered water into a 100 cm Liquid Waveguide Capillary
Flow Cell (LWCC-3100) from World Precision Instruments, refiltering
the water through an additional 0.22 micrometer syringe filter.
	
3. Measure the absorbance using an Ocean Optics USB-200 spectrometer.
	
4. Reduce noise by adjusting values gradually closer to a fitted
linear curve in log-log space for wavelengths longer than 550 nm.

Reference: Kristoffersen, Arne S., et al. "Optical properties of
Norwegian fjords influenced by glacial meltwater and a coccolithophore
bloom." Progress in Oceanography (2026): 103727.

Column 1: Wavelength [nm]
Column 2: Absorption coefficient [m^{-1}]
*/
